usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear, well-sourced picture of who Michelle Gass is: born 1968 (née Petkers), chemical engineering degree (WPI, 1990), career start at Procter & Gamble, ~17 years at Starbucks including EMEA president and Frappuccino brand manager, Kohl's CEO from May 2018 with a late-2022 exit, Levi Strauss & Co. president from January 2023 and CEO since early 2024, plus PepsiCo and retail-industry board seats. A reader learns both identity and actual accomplishments, and could prepare for a meeting (current role, career arc, board affiliations, recognition). The dossier does flag epistemic status — two claims marked 'contested' and several 'claimed' — which partially discloses what is not fully verified, but it never explicitly states its gaps or what remains unknown (e.g., no note on the discrepancy between the 2023 Retail Dive 'currently serves' wording and the 2024 NRF corroboration, and no explicit statement of missing information), so it falls short of a full score on remaining questions. Notably, none of the listed unjustified conclusions appear as dossier statements: the Frappuccino claim is correctly phrased as 'credited with,' the chemical engineering claim is limited to the degree, and no statement asserts she is currently Kohl's CEO.
